summarization.headline: Brightside Bakery Co. leases its retail unit at 48 Mill Street to Westgate Property Holdings LLC for $3,400.00 a month.
key_points: Westgate Property Holdings pays a $6,800.00 security deposit.

Brightside Bakery Co. maintains the roof and structure
